summary: Round 2 plan-only re-review of the revised PLAN.md. No blocking findings. The two round-1 requests are incorporated and their new text is supported by the pinned PR298 source: PublicationD2H.enqueue copies every published group to host at enqueue time (gpu_d2h.py:189-198), independent of any later .on_cpu access, and gpu_d2h_chunk_size is retired with only zero accepted (ds_base.py:66,87-88), so the plan's keepalive-not-publish rule, the 64 MiB gpu_d2h_pinned_bytes default (ds_base.py:65) and the fail-on-image-publication gate are correct. PS_JF_SHARE_DERIVED=0 does disable the derived Jungfrau shared-calibration branch (mpi_ds.py:266-268); smd0 alone loads constants, builds the XTC buffer and broadcasts it, BD ranks clear their own and receive dsparms.calibconst from the shared window (mpi_ds.py:103-116,184-263), and the task constants are uploaded from dsparms.calibconst at pipeline setup (gpu_events.py:553-560; gpu_task_batch.py:82,202-213), so the plan's 'frozen arrays through a reviewed smd0/MPI buffer path, verified per BD before timing' is a real and correctly described path. The RunSerial-only patch in the capacity runner (runner.py:80-81) remains inapplicable under MPI as the plan states. Unchanged factual numbers re-checked against summary.csv-derived checks.json (579.34/652.17 +12.57 %, 1635.45/1606.41; bank 6,710,887,200 B; subtotals 18,186,502,944/133,143,989,376/66,571,994,688/33,285,997,344 B = 16.9375/124/62/31 GiB; 4.378594 GiB/s). runtime-check.json is a source/Git-hash record only and native-compatibility.json is the staging receipt; neither is a fresh build or GPU test, and the plan does not claim otherwise. The plan still requires user confirmation of the four-GPU/100-bin topology, implementation review, and new job authorization, and represents no runtime test as passed. Three new low, nonblocking notes: the pinned runtime exposes no fallback counter or per-group copy-byte metric so the plan's publication audit must be derived harness-side; the adopted native receipt records a psana/meson.build mismatch between PR source and the frozen native build that the plan should carry forward as a provenance caveat; and PS_GEO_SHARE-gated shared geometry/calibc caches (mpi_ds.py:329-332) are a second derived-artifact path not covered by pinning PS_JF_SHARE_DERIVED alone.
checks: Read the full revised PLAN.md (284 lines, all nine sections), review-01.json, response-01.md, scope.md, checks.json, runtime-check.json and evidence/native-compatibility.json (head, status/pr_sha/frozen_build/config_mismatches and tail) in the snapshot.

Verified task constant upload: gpu_events.py:542-560 selects SharedRequestedConstants when placement.can_share else RequestedConstants and refreshes from dsparms.calibconst; gpu_task_batch.py:82-83,202-213 exposes uploaded device arrays via batch.calibconst(detector,key), uploaded once per run; _snapshot_memory (gpu_events.py:256-276) reports output_d2h.pinned_bytes and borrowed/imported constants, supporting the plan's charged-versus-uncharged ledger.

Confirmed the plan keeps the proposed-experiment framing: user topology/100-bin decision (PLAN.md:14-17,280-283), separately reviewed task variant rather than guard removal (PLAN.md:129-136), no automatic full run after failed gates, no runtime test claimed as passed, and no job/commit authority asserted.
limitations: Read/Glob/Grep only: no commands executed, no hashing performed; file identity against the manifest SHA256 values is taken from the supplied snapshot paths. I did not run check_plan.py; checks.json values were recomputed by hand.
The pinned PR298 runtime was inspected at the attempt01/pr-source tree; its commit identity 67c327a1 is taken from runtime-check.json and native-compatibility.json, not verified by me.
Shared-scratch free space, node availability, A100 free bytes, and all runtime memory/publication behaviour are unverified; plan statements about them are accepted as coordinator observations.

The native-compatibility receipt was read at its snapshot copy; the original path listed in the manifest is outside the permitted directories and was not read. The frozen native build B itself was not inspected.
This is acceptance of plan reasoning and arithmetic only, not of any task variant, MPI runner, fixture, harness instrumentation, or launch; the four-GPU/100-bin decision remains with the user.

findings.evidence: PLAN.md:87-89 requires recording 'actual task-publication copy bytes, pinned high water and ordinary-host fallback count' and failing on 'any ordinary-host task-output fallback in the timed loop'. The pinned runtime exposes only the aggregate charged pinned capacity (gpu_d2h.py:132-134 pinned_bytes; surfaced in gpu_events.py:270-272) and keeps no counter of per-group copy bytes or of overflow copies: _destination silently returns np.empty with blocking=True when the page-rounded size exceeds the cap (gpu_d2h.py:136-152,198). PLAN.md:148-150 also forbids editing the frozen staging and historical packages and the task forbids core-code edits, so these three records cannot come from the runtime as-is.
findings.requested_change: State how the audit values are obtained without editing core code: e.g., the harness sums the nbytes of its own publish() calls per callback and compares the page-rounded total against gpu_d2h_pinned_bytes, reads _output_d2h.pinned_bytes before/after the timed loop as the high-water proxy, and treats any callback whose rounded publication exceeds remaining capacity as a fallback; or declare that direct fallback observation needs a harness-side instrumentation wrapper that is itself part of the implementation review. Label the derived values as derived, not runtime counters.

findings.evidence: PLAN.md:35-36 adopts 'the recorded native-compatibility receipt' as part of the frozen runtime. evidence/native-compatibility.json reports status 'pass' but also records config_mismatches for psana/meson.build (pr 4cd07821... vs frozen 27ae0bce...) between the PR298 source and the frozen native build pr187-pr208-integration-20261026-r1/B. The staging runner validates only the receipt's kvikio_identity block (notes/sim10_storage_gpu_20261114/runner.py:56), and runtime-check.json covers six Python files plus Git HEAD, so the mismatch is inherited rather than re-examined for the compute stages.
findings.requested_change: In 'Fixed controls and historical interpretation', note that the adopted receipt carries a recorded psana/meson.build configuration mismatch between PR source and the frozen native build, that the compute cohort inherits this caveat unchanged from the staging campaign, and that no new native build is claimed or authorized by this plan.

findings.evidence: PLAN.md:172-174 pins PS_JF_SHARE_DERIVED=0 and asks to 'verify no unexpected derived-cache artifacts'. In the pinned mpi_ds.py the RunParallel calibration setup also calls _setup_jungfrau_shared_caches (mpi_ds.py:125), which is gated by a different variable PS_GEO_SHARE defaulting to on (mpi_ds.py:329-332) and, for Jungfrau area detectors, builds shared geometry and CalibConstants-derived pixel-index caches in MPI shared memory and seeds them from calibconst on the leader (mpi_ds.py:343-412). With constants present in EC/ECC but empty in S/E, this path does different setup work per stage; it is outside the timed interval but is an unpinned derived-artifact and host-memory contributor.
findings.requested_change: Extend the pinned-environment sentence to record PS_GEO_SHARE (pin it explicitly to one value for every stage of the first cohort) and include the shared geometry/calibc caches in the 'no unexpected derived-cache artifacts' check and in the reported setup time and resident host bytes.
